Runge interpolation: nodes, representation and rounding Interpolate the Runge and absolute-value functions on fixed equispaced and Lobatto-like nodes, and compare with Clenshaw evaluation. Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless interval [-1,1], degrees 8, 16 and 32, and 2048 fixed midpoints. Actual binary64 nodes, data and weights define the discrete problem. Editorial clarification A sampled maximum error is not a proof of a continuous uniform norm. Closed weights and discrete orthogonality on rounded nodes are not treated as exact. No arbitrary-degree or all-point stability guarantee is made. Adopted numerical method Implement the second barycentric formula and a full-coefficient Clenshaw recurrence.
